name: frontend-templates
description: A modular frontend blueprint to kickstart modern web projects. Includes shared base configs and stack-specific branches.

scripts.format: npm run prettier:write && npm run lint:fix
scripts.lint: npm run lint:formatting && npm run lint:editorconfig && npm run eslint && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:fix: npm run eslint:fix && npm run lint:md:fix
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run check:copypaste && npm run check:spell && npm audit
